messages.subject: Project Quartz - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Daniel, Rebecca,

Completion took place today. Thornbury is now the registered owner (subject to registration) of Quartz House. The seller's bank charge will be discharged via the undertaking received this morning. We'll file the SDLT return (£412,000) within 14 days, apply to register the transfer at HM Land Registry, and serve notices of assignment of the reversion on the tenants.

Executed TR1 and the SDLT summary attached.

Thank you all - a pleasure to act.

James
